title: Updates
unsupported: Development builds don’t check for updates
readyBody: Hermesh {{version}} has been downloaded and verified.
background: You can close this window. The download will continue in the background.
installOnQuit: This update installs when Hermesh quits. Restart now to use it immediately.
laterHint: Later hides the sidebar reminder for 24 hours. Quitting still installs the downloaded update.
notesMissing: Release highlights aren’t available here yet. You can read the full notes in your browser.
noHistory: Read the release history in your browser.
approvalBody: An approval is still pending. Return to it before restarting Hermesh.

error.network: Couldn’t check for updates. Check your internet connection.
error.location: Hermesh can update itself only from the Applications folder. Move it there in Finder, then try again.
error.download: Couldn’t download the update. Hermesh will try again later.

install.heading: Install
install.mac: **On a Mac**, to approve and run coding agents: `Hermesh-macos-arm64.dmg` (Apple silicon) or `Hermesh-macos-x64.dmg` (Intel)
install.windows: **On a Windows 11 PC**, to approve and run coding agents: `Hermesh-windows-x64-setup.exe`, or `Hermesh-windows-arm64-setup.exe` on Arm. It isn't signed yet: Windows warns once, and More info › Run anyway installs it
install.machine: **On a machine for coding agents** (Linux or macOS): `{{command}}`
install.device: **On a Linux computer that only approves**: the same command, ending `sh -s -- --device`
install.cli: **For your agent's CLI**: the same command, ending `sh -s -- --cli`
install.note: The other files are for the installer and the app's updates; there's no need to download them by hand.
